items.headline: First messenger RNA flu vaccine approved in the United States
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration approved Moderna's mFlusiva for adults fifty and older, the first flu vaccine built on messenger RNA technology. In a trial of more than forty thousand people, it prevented about twenty seven percent more flu cases than a standard flu shot.
items.why_it_matters: It brings the faster-updating, better-matched vaccine platform behind COVID shots to seasonal flu, for the age group most at risk of severe illness.
